output.review_comment: The PR fixes critical bugs (all teams should appear in output, add input validation) which are necessary. However, it introduces unjustified specification changes: the tiebreaker logic was reversed from "larger headcount" to "smaller headcount" in both the docstring and code (via -headcounts[team]). This contradicts the original spec. Since no test actually exercises this tiebreaker scenario with unequal headcounts, the change appears to be test-specific modification of the specification itself rather than implementation of the agreed specification. Request: revert the docstring change back to "larger headcount" and remove the negation from the tiebreaker logic to restore the original specification.
